title: Tracks and lifting arrangements for a shared roll-changing carriage on a continuous annealing furnace
summary: Suneng's 2014 technical agreement for a 1250 mm continuous annealing and pickling line uses disc-roll assemblies with small water-cooled rolls, serviced by a shared roll-changing trolley, a movable track frame and the workshop crane. Beyond trolley availability, check access to every working position, alignment of movable and fixed tracks, and the connections between power, cooling and seal states.
